pages.title: Runeword Microchips
pages.text: Three exotic subatomic semiconductors drop from the triad of Diablo-inspired bosses:$(br2)• $(b)Quantum (JAH)$(0): The Skeleton King$(br)• $(5)Dimensional (ITH)$(0): The Cow King$(br)• $(c)Atomic (BER)$(0): The Carver

pages.title: The Enigma Protocol
pages.text: When all three semiconductors are transmuted together with $(6)Ember$(0) in the $(b)Transmutation Cube$(0), they awaken $(6)Enigma Ember$(0) (JAH-ITH-BER)—granting near-instantaneous 2-tick teleportation!
